summary: Iteration 136 QA — Chat Mentions & Alerts, Turn-message-into-decision, Auto-Escalate Brief. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter136_crisis_ops.py — 12 passed, 0 failed in 8.33s (serial run). Verified: (a) POST /api/crisis/cases/{ref}/messages resolves @<full role> against crisis_participants; response payload includes mentions[] with matching {name,role,contact}; partial token like '@Legal' does NOT match compound role 'Legal / Privacy' (as designed — chips supply full string); message without @-mentions returns empty mentions[]. No _id leak. (b) POST /api/crisis/cases/{ref}/messages/{msg_id}/to-action creates a crisis action {action_type:'Decision', status:'Awaiting Approval', decision_required:true, source:'War Room Chat', title=<message text>}; the source message is marked converted_action_id=ACT-####; a Decision timeline event with title 'War room message escalated to decision ACT-####' is written; case actions list contains it; re-conversion returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Already tracked as ACT-####'; unknown message_id returns 404; approve flow (PATCH status=Approved) transitions to Approved. (c) PATCH /api/crisis/cases/{ref} — High->Critical with cadence=0 auto-sets brief_schedule_hours=4 AND writes an Auto-Escalation Communication event containing 'every 4h'; when case is already Critical (cadence=24 pre-set) a subsequent severity=Critical PATCH does NOT re-escalate (cadence stays 24, no new Auto-Escalation event); High->Critical WITH explicit brief_schedule_hours=24 in same PATCH is respected (cadence=24, no Auto-Escalation event). (d) Regression: /api/crisis/insight grounded 200, /api/connectors/health 200, /api/crisis/ingest/servicenow returns honest 400 'not connected', chat list has no _id leakage. Frontend (Playwright, admin login via /api/auth/login fetch to workaround the UI form not persisting session, then navigated via nav-cyber-crisis-commander): on /app/cyber-crisis-commander after Demo seed — War Room tab (crisis-tab-warroom) renders crisis-war-room-chat with 8 mention chips built from the live roster (crisis-chat-mention-Incident-Commander, -CISO, -CIO, -Legal---Privacy, -Communications, -Finance, -Business-Continuity, -Cyber-Insurance). Clicking crisis-chat-mention-Incident-Commander inserts '@Incident Commander ' into crisis-chat-input; posting via crisis-chat-send renders the message in crisis-chat-thread with a 'pinged' line. crisis-chat-to-action-MSG-#### button visible on the new message; clicking POSTs to /messages/{id}/to-action, message flips to crisis-chat-tracked-MSG-#### badge showing 'ACT-0122'. Decision Room tab (crisis-tab-decisions) shows the new action with 'Awaiting Approval' status via the existing approve flow. No _id leakage observed anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: crisis_commander.py:post_message — mention matching uses a full-string containment check (`f'@{token.lower()}' in lowered`). This is order-sensitive and would ALSO match '@Incident Commander today' correctly but '@Communications Lead' would match participant role 'Communications' (i.e. partial-prefix match). This is documented in the spec as expected (chips supply the full role), but consider a word-boundary check like re.search(r'@' + re.escape(token) + r'\b', text, re.IGNORECASE) to avoid false positives where the @token is a prefix of a longer phrase.

crisis_commander.py:message_to_action — action.title truncates to 220 chars but does not strip HTML/markdown; if in future the chat allows rich text the Decision Room title could render unescaped content. Consider stripping/sanitising here (currently plain text so safe).

crisis_commander.py:message_to_action — 400 on already-converted is correct, but the endpoint returns 400 even when the message exists in a different case/org (via 404 first). Ensure org isolation stays consistent under multi-tenant load; _get_case + message find_one both scope on org_id which is correct.

crisis_commander.py:update_case auto-escalate — condition `current_cadence == 0 or current_cadence > 4` means a case explicitly set to cadence=1/2/3 (tighter than 4h) is treated as 'already aggressive' and left alone; documented correctly. However a case at cadence=4 exactly is also skipped (because `>4` is false and `==0` is false) — this is fine but worth a code comment for future maintainers.

crisis_commander.py:update_case — the Auto-Escalation event write happens BEFORE the audit event; consider wrapping the set+event in an ordered transaction (or at least a single mongo update) so partial failure doesn't leave cadence changed with no timeline record.

CyberCrisisCommander.jsx:WarRoomChat — 'Turn into decision' button is operator-gated in JSX but relies on client role check; backend `_require_operator` is the real gate (verified good). Fine, but consider hiding the button entirely if the current session isn't operator to avoid confusing 403 toasts.

Frontend auth: submitting the login form (auth-submit) with Playwright's programmatic click completed the navigation to '/' but did NOT persist the httpOnly access_token cookie across the very next document navigation in some cases (posthog SW/CF interaction?). Directly POSTing /api/auth/login via fetch inside the page did set the cookies. Not a functional bug for real users, but worth investigating — could indicate a race where the form submit's cookie set arrives AFTER the redirect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mention chips render, chip->input insertion, mention resolution + 'pinged' line, turn-into-decision creates ACT-#### and tracked badge, Decision Room shows Awaiting Approval)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/crisis/demo/seed used (returns/refreshes case, this run: CRISIS-0018/CRISIS-0019). Created several TEST_iter136 chat messages and one Decision action via to-action.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests SERIALLY: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter136_crisis_ops.py -o addopts=""`. Key iter-136 testids: crisis-war-room-chat, crisis-chat-mentions, crisis-chat-mention-<role-with-spaces-replaced-by-dashes-and-slashes-replaced-by-triple-dash> (e.g. Legal / Privacy -> crisis-chat-mention-Legal---Privacy), crisis-chat-input, crisis-chat-send, crisis-chat-thread, crisis-chat-msg-<id>, crisis-chat-to-action-<msg_id>, crisis-chat-tracked-<msg_id>. For playwright, LOGIN VIA FETCH inside the page instead of submitting the login form — the httpOnly cookie sometimes doesn't survive the immediate post-form redirect (fetch flow reliably sets access_token+refresh_token). Then navigate via `page.goto('/app')` and click nav-cyber-crisis-commander (the crisis commander mounts under /app/cyber-crisis-commander, not root /cyber-crisis-commander). Decision Room tab testid is crisis-tab-decisions.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All three iter-136 features behave per spec end-to-end: (1) mention resolution correctly matches full role/name from crisis_participants and populates message.mentions[]; _post_chat_alert is fired best-effort (safe no-op without configured webhook); (2) to-action creates a Decision-type crisis_action awaiting approval, marks the message converted, writes a Decision timeline event, and 400s on repeat; approve flow via existing PATCH works; (3) auto-escalate triggers ONLY on the specific transition (severity: non-Critical -> Critical) with no explicit brief_schedule_hours in the same PATCH and current cadence in {0, >4}; user-explicit cadence is respected.
